en: The Sūtra Spoken by the Buddha on Prolonging Life.
Homage to the Greatly Compassionate and Greatly Merciful Avalokiteśvara, Savior from Suffering.

I pray only that your holy hand may stroke my crown, and that you may rescue and protect those with heavy karmic offenses in this Sahā world, establishing them securely upon the ground of nirvāṇa and liberation.
In making offerings to all Buddhas and delivering all beings— just as a shadow follows a form—
I vow to constantly uphold this and never let it be forsaken.

In the Western Quarter, Amitābha Buddha, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, and Mahāsthāmaprāpta Bodhisattva possess such power that anyone who recites the names of this one Buddha and two Bodhisattvas [shall attain liberation].
They shall be free from the suffering of birth and death and never again enter hell;
they will always encounter virtuous consciousnesses.
For those who have doubts or difficulties:
Reciting this sutra one thousand times will immediately bring about liberation. First, may the Triple Gem endure forever. Second, may wind and rain fall according to the seasons.

Third, may the life of the King last ten thousand years. Fourth, may there be no lands of swords in the border regions. Fifth, may those in the three miserable realms be freed from suffering. Sixth, may all hundred-fold ailments be completely eliminated. Seventh, may sentient beings practice kindness and filial piety. Eighth, may butchers refrain from killing living beings. Ninth, may prisoners and captives obtain release. Tenth, may the entire Dharma-realm be universally peaceful and secure. May my eyes never behold the glare of blades; May my ears never hear the sounds of enmity or calamity; May my mouth never utter words that cause harm; May my hands never kill a single living being. In general, may we encounter Maitreya in the future, And together, through these successive protections, enter the City of Transformation.
The Scripture on Reading Fate Spoken by the Buddha
